Krusader 2.6.1 opens both panels in your storage folder on a fresh install.

## ✨ Added

- **Both panels start in /storage.** A fresh install opened in /config, the container's own settings folder. An existing install keeps the folders it had open when Krusader last closed.
- **No first-run wizard.** A fresh install opens straight into Krusader instead of the welcome dialog, the tool check and the Konfigurator.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Updated Selkies base** from LinuxServer.io.
- **A compose file and notes for other Docker hosts**, and README buttons for ZimaOS, Umbrel and MOS.
